terraces_resident.text: Come in, pet. Mind the cat, she thinks she is the landlady.
If a chipgull spots your bag of chips, you are already too slow. Tuck them under your arm and walk like you mean it.
My Callum is off to the Toon with his scarf on, and his pyjama bottoms still on underneath. Bairns, eh.
The Angel of the North is up the road. When I was little it was brand new, and now bairns say it has always been there.

then.text: Back for the Stottie Cake? Kitchen's yours.

else.text: Howay in, pet. A stottie is a loaf, not a cake, don't ask me why.
Knock the dough about, dimple the top with your thumb, and bake it flat. Split, then ham and pease pudding. A proper Tyneside sandwich.
Pop in whenever you've got the makings. Use my kitchen.
